newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Officer court martialled for sex with sailor's wife.
newsitem.headline: Officer court martialled for sex with sailor's wife.

text.p: A naval commander accused of having sex with the wife of one of his sailors is being court-martialled for conduct unbecoming an officer, the South African Navy said on Wednesday.
The case is believed to be the first of its kind in South Africa.
Navy spokesman Commander Stan Slogrove told Reuters that Commander Brian Power of the strike-craft SAS Jan Smuts is appearing before a court-martial in the Indian Ocean port city of Durban.
"This is the first such case according to my memory ... If the charges are proved they will be viewed in a very serious light," Slogrove said, declining to give further details.

The charge sheet accuses Power of acting in a ..."scandalous manner unbecoming the character of an officer and a gentleman by having sexual intercourse with Mrs. Luanne Edwards, the wife of ... Leading Seaman Brendan Peter Edwards, the latter being subordinate to the accused".
The relationship allegedly took place at the end of May this year.
The court-martial is scheduled to end on Thursday.
